metadata.description: Likely represents a domain for setting cookies in the UI.

suggestions: Provide a valid domain name to ensure cookies are properly scoped.
If this value is intentionally empty, document its purpose for clarity.

metadata.description: Likely represents the name for a cookie used in the UI.

suggestions: Provide a meaningful cookie name to identify its purpose.
If this value is intentionally empty, document its purpose for clarity.

metadata.description: Specifies the login type or authentication provider used in the UI.

suggestions: Ensure the login type matches the expected authentication provider.
Document supported login types in the application's configuration guide.

metadata.description: Appears to be a password for the site login or authentication.
metadata.expected_format: Strong password (e.g., alphanumeric with special characters)

suggestions: Store this value in a secure secrets management system.
Ensure the password follows strong security practices and policies.
Avoid hardcoding sensitive credentials in environment variables.

metadata.description: Appears to be a username in the form of an email address for site login or authentication.

suggestions: Store this value in a secure secrets management system if it is sensitive.
Ensure the email address is valid and corresponds to an actual user account.
